mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay near their current depressed levels for another month, weekday shopping trips will remain suppressed and RETAIL_REC will stay below its prior four-week mean over the next 4 weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES is around -13% to -13.4% and TRANSIT around -35% to -36.7% across the snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages above its prior 28-day mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT do not recover from the current depressed range within the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A further rise in RESIDENTIAL time above the current level signals more time spent at home, which directly diverts discretionary trips from retail and recreation and lowers RETAIL_REC within 1 week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 5.0% for a weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 4.4% to 4.9% in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 7 days after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 5.0% and instead rises relative to the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rebounds sharply from a weak week, it pulls leisure outings away from retail venues first and then crowding effects normalize after two weeks, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 8 points week-on-week from a negative baseline
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -19.7 to -33.9 after a prior rebound, while RETAIL_REC stayed near -14
failure_condition: After an 8-point weekly increase in PARKS, RETAIL_REC does not decline over the following 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below pre-period levels by more than 30 and 10 points respectively, commute-linked retail demand stays weak and RETAIL_REC is lower over the next 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -30 and WORKPLACES remains below -10 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is near -35% to -37% and WORKPLACES near -12% to -13% in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 28-day mean despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES staying below the stated thresholds for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GROCERY_PHARM indicates routine essential trips are absorbing consumer time and budget; if that series remains positive while RETAIL_REC stays negative, discretionary retail mobility will edge lower over the next 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0 for two consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is positive in t-1w and t-0w while RETAIL_REC remains around -13.6 to -13.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 14 days even though GROCERY_PHARM stays above zero for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized lift in PARKS and RESIDENTIAL is a warm-weather substitution pattern: more outdoor and home-based activity reduces indoor shopping visits, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next 4 weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is volatile and RESIDENTIAL is persistently above baseline in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over 28 days while both PARKS and RESIDENTIAL trend upward together for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, stable or rising TRANSIT acts as a feeder for mall and corridor shopping; if transit stops falling and turns positive momentum within 1 week, RETAIL_REC should improve quickly.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by at least 2 points week-on-week from a level below -30
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is around -35% to -37% at the decision point
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise within 7 days after TRANSIT improves by at least 2 points from below -30.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue to recover together, the commuting network will rebuild weekday foot traffic and support a higher RETAIL_REC average over the next 4 weeks than over the last 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES has been slightly improving at times while TRANSIT remains deeply negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not outperform its prior 28-day mean after two straight weeks of simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.
